humanMessage: Approve the remaining phase 7 → 6 → 4 → 5 → 8 as described, including implementation, testing, scoped deployments and audit tracking. Bring the tested production-data, recovery-configuration and additional-deletion plans back for final approval.

approvedScope.7: Latest logical backup restored only into an isolated PostgreSQL cluster; verify rows, roles, accounting, replay and integrity. Prepare and test recovery/PITR plan. Retain last restore-proven backup until replacement is proven; no pin change without final approval.
approvedScope.6: Diagnose and implement documented Wallet WORK timeout, ID semantics, bond pagination and positive-WORK rendering corrections; tests and scoped production code releases.
approvedScope.4: Correct byte-preserving mail parsing, storage preparation and rendering; prepare exact affected-record projection-rebuild plan.
approvedScope.5: Isolated lossless transition-storage prototype and deterministic exact math/replay equivalence; prepare migration and rollback.
approvedScope.8: Missing artifact custody and treasury/refund/bounty reconciliation; capture exact node Git index path/bytes/owners/prior metadata and repair only documented0664-to0600 mode defect; prepare exact safe node cleanup.

approvedSupportingActions: Controlled API/indexer-worker code deployments and necessary restarts
Local and production verification preserving existing protocol/accounting rules
Repository hygiene and enabled commit hooks
Standing release announcements after committed/pushed/deployed/verified updates
finalApprovalRequired: Production mail projection or database/schema/storage rebuild or migration
Production WAL/PITR activation, backup-pin changes or PostgreSQL/full-node restart
Additional backup/node artifact retirement outside existing explicitly approved policy
Correction or mutation of protected historical/ledger records
persistentConstraints: Canonical protocol forms, Q8/Q16 exact math, immutable chain history and1000/546 proof rules preserved
Existing holds, masks, pins and capacity guards preserved
Recovery verification precedes production data rebuilds/migrations
Unknown or failed evidence remains qualified; do not invent recovery/custody/retirement
Wallet authority and signing remain local to the human

isolatedRestoreBoundaries.network: private Unix socket, no TCP listener
isolatedRestoreBoundaries.backupSource: fresh verified latest complete set under existing shared backup lock; exact byte/metadata plan before run
isolatedRestoreBoundaries.evidence: preserve old scripts, failed jobs, backups and all receipts; no data deletion
